items.title: MSQUIC IPv6包堆溢出远程代码执行
items.title_zh: MSQUIC IPv6包堆溢出远程代码执行
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者向Windows上.NET服务的HTTP/3路径发送特制IPv6 QUIC包，触发堆溢出实现远程代码执行。
items.action_zh: 升级到修复版本2.5.11-ci.159417053并同步更新.NET运行时
items.repro_note: 向HTTP/3端口发送构造的IPv6 QUIC包，目标需启用QUIC，无需认证
items.impact_scope: Windows .NET HTTP/3服务，可能暴露公网
items.description: ## Executive summary Microsoft is releasing this security advisory to provide information about a vulnerability in Microsoft QUIC as used by .NET 8.0, .NET 9.0, .NET 10.0, and .NET 11 RC2 on Windows. A crafted IPv6 QUIC packet can reach the Microsoft QUIC HTTP/3 path without authentication or user interaction and trigger remote code execution.

items.title: ColdFusion任意文件上传RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可上传危险类型文件，无需用户交互即可执行任意代码，CVSS 10。
items.affected: Adobe(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级ColdFusion至厂商修复版本，限制上传与公网暴露
items.repro_note: 定位上传接口，构造危险类型文件验证代码执行
items.description: ColdFusion is affected by an Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

items.title: Legacy Update网页控件滥用
items.summary_zh: 诱使IE用户访问恶意网页，可枚举系统、静默装更新、弹窗或重启，CVSS 9.9。
items.action_zh: 升级Legacy Update，避免IE访问不可信网页
items.repro_note: IE访问恶意页调用控件，验证系统枚举/更新
items.description: Legacy Update is a tool for activating and installing updates on legacy Windows PCs. An attacker who induces a user to visit a malicious webpage in Internet Explorer can invoke the control to enumerate update and system information, install updates without consent, display dialogs, or restart the computer when a reboot is pending.

items.title: Vitess默认ACL跨站脚本
items.summary_zh: 默认allow-all ACL下，未认证攻击者可发请求，操作员打开后执行脚本，CVSS 9.8。
items.action_zh: 升级Vitess，调整ACL并避免直接打开请求
items.repro_note: 未认证发送含脚本请求，操作员打开触发
items.impact_scope: Vitess管理面，需操作员查看请求
items.description: Vitess is a database clustering system for horizontal scaling of MySQL. Under the default allow-all ACL policy, a remote unauthenticated attacker can send an operator a crafted request that executes script in the operator's browser after the request is opened.

items.title: PHP应用SQL注入导致未授权RCE
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者通过SQL注入重新触发安装程序，向config.inc.php注入PHP代码，在目标系统远程执行任意代码。
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复信息；修复SQL注入点并禁用可重触发安装程序的入口
items.repro_note: SQL注入点触发installer重装，向config.inc.php写入PHP代码，无需认证
items.impact_scope: PHP业务系统，暴露公网则风险更高
items.description: Attackers can exploit the SQL injection to re-trigger the installer and inject arbitrary PHP code into config.inc.php, achieving unauthenticated remote code execution on the underlying system.

items.title: Xoscar反序列化未授权远程代码执行
items.title_zh: Xoscar反序列化未授权远程代码执行
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者向actor-pool TCP通道发送恶意序列化数据触发反序列化，在目标主机执行任意代码。
items.action_zh: 升级Xoscar至修复版本；无法升级时对actor-pool通道做网络隔离
items.repro_note: 向actor-pool TCP端口发送恶意序列化数据，无需认证
items.impact_scope: 分布式计算集群actor通道，内网横向
items.description: Xorbits Xoscar through 0.11.2 contains an unauthenticated deserialization vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by sending crafted data over the actor-pool TCP channel. Attackers can exploit SocketChannel.recv() passing unvalidated data to cloudpickle.loads(), which triggers pickle __reduce__ gadget execution before message type validation, achieving remote code execution as the server process which commonly runs as root on GPU nodes.
